## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: extremely weak sector breadth (only Healthcare positive) and major divergence across large caps (AAPL, NVDA, INTC, QCOM, TSLA showing 1W vs 1M discord); Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: TMO (1W: +3.20% | 1M: +9.31%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +0.85%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +3.27% | 1M: -2.03%) RECOVERY. Energy/Technology are the next best relative performers but are mixed and not broadly positive.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Real Estate, Materials and Utilities are weakest: CCI (1W: -7.32% | 1M: -10.63%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -7.99% | 1M: -8.32%) BELOW TREND, Utilities overall 1W: -1.83% (10 stocks) showing sector weakness.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: RCL (1W: +10.98% | 1M: -6.15%) RECOVERY; AMAT (1W: +8.37% | 1M: +10.90%) ABOVE TREND; ASML (1W: +4.95% | 1M: +8.15%) ABOVE TREND; LRCX (1W: +4.26% | 1M: +7.39%) ABOVE TREND; MAR (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +3.00%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology) — concentration risk.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: EL (1W: -5.90% | 1M: -8.41%) BELOW TREND; F (1W: -6.11% | 1M: -11.38%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -6.40% | 1M: +29.57%) CORRECTION; MCD (1W: -6.54% | 1M: -11.08%) BELOW TREND; TSLA (1W: -6.88% | 1M: +1.17%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in Consumer sectors and select large-cap tech names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: RCL (1W: +10.98%), AMAT (1W: +8.37%), ASML (1W: +4.95%), LRCX (1W: +4.26%), TXN (1W: +3.79%). Market shows MAJOR divergence (multiple marquee names with 1W ≠ 1M) — tactical opportunities, not clear broad trend.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed, net-negative on 1W: Technology (1W: -1.30% | 1M: +1.99%; 24 stocks) with leaders in semiconductors: AMAT (1W: +8.37% | 1M: +10.90%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +4.95% | 1M: +8.15%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +4.26% | 1M: +7.39%) ABOVE TREND while large-cap software/hardware names show corrections or below-trend readings (AAPL CORRECTION, ORCL BELOW TREND).

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft on 1W: Financials (1W: -1.23% | 1M: -6.26%; 20 stocks) with mixed internals — JPM (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: +1.06% | 1M: -4.12%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +1.38% | 1M: -5.33%) RECOVERY — cyclical support is limited and breadth is weak.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Only clear sector showing strength: Healthcare (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -0.96%; 17 stocks) led by TMO (1W: +3.20% | 1M: +9.31%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +0.85%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +2.83% | 1M: +2.72%) ABOVE TREND — defensive accumulation visible.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Remain selective in a NEUTRAL regime: favor Healthcare names showing ABOVE TREND strength (TMO, LLY, PFE) and selective semicap exposure (AMAT, ASML, LRCX) while reducing exposure to clear BELOW TREND consumers and weak large-cap tech (EL, MCD, ORCL). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; monitor for leadership breadth expansion before broad positioning.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +8.37% | 1M: +10.90%) ABOVE TREND, RCL (1W: +10.98% | 1M: -6.15%) RECOVERY, TMO (1W: +3.20% | 1M: +9.31%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -8.66%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -5.90% | 1M: -8.41%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -5.67% | 1M: -12.12%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +0.71%; only positive sector) for relative safety and earnings-related catalysts. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary and Materials where multiple names are below-trend and sentiment-driven volatility is high.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch semicap continuation: AMAT — confirm continuation above recent breakout to validate ABOVE TREND; NVDA — hold 1M support to avoid broader tech pullback (NVDA (1W: -0.73% | 1M: +4.56%) CORRECTION); AAPL — failure to reclaim 1M support would deepen CORRECTION (AAPL (1W: -3.05% | 1M: +3.03%) CORRECTION).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
RCL (+55): Carnival surge on record bookings — RCL (1W: +10.98% | 1M: -6.15%) RECOVERY — price confirming positive news. AMAT (+50): EPIC center tie to AI memory — AMAT (1W: +8.37% | 1M: +10.90%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. LLY (+50): weight-loss data edge — LLY (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +0.85%) ABOVE TREND — confirming accumulation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ORCL (-50): bond/yield headlines weighing — ORCL (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -8.66%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. XOM (-50): geopolitical fine chatter — XOM (1W: +1.66% | 1M: +2.96%) ABOVE TREND — news diverging from price, watch for follow-through. NVS (-50): program pauses in trials — NVS (1W: +3.14% | 1M: -5.27%) RECOVERY — news is bearish while price shows short-term bounce, monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology). TMO, AMAT and ASML showing relative strength (TMO ABOVE TREND; AMAT ABOVE TREND; ASML ABOVE TREND). Key risk: MAJOR divergence across large caps (AAPL, NVDA, INTC, QCOM, TSLA) and mixed news signals (ORCL/XOM divergences) — watch for trend confirmation before expanding exposure.
